title: A filter in the water
hook: A moving stream can carry food.

knows: Animals can have structures and life stages that differ from humans.
doesNotKnow: In the first panel particles enter with water; in the second some particles are shown caught at a simplified internal filter. Bivalve feeding and particle selection vary, so the drawing does not imply that every particle is eaten.

misconception: The observations in this scenario require a different interpretation.
objective: A filter-feeding bivalve draws in water containing suspended particles. What can it retain from that water as food?
